coupons_value_ck.name: coupons_value_ck
coupons_value_ck.value: ("coupons"."type" = 'percent' and "coupons"."value" between 1 and 100) or ("coupons"."type" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."value" > 0) or ("coupons"."type" = 'free_shipping')

products_age_ck.name: products_age_ck
products_age_ck.value: "products"."min_age_months" is null or "products"."max_age_months" is null or "products"."min_age_months" <= "products"."max_age_months"

promotions_value_ck.name: promotions_value_ck
promotions_value_ck.value: ("promotions"."kind" = 'percent_off' and "promotions"."value" between 1 and 90) or ("promotions"."kind" = 'fixed_off' and "promotions"."value" > 0) or ("promotions"."kind" = 'free_shipping')
